methods.label: Apply the signed addition rules
methods.explanation: To add two numbers with opposite signs, use the sign of the number with the greater absolute value, then subtract the smaller absolute value from the greater one: \(-(8-5)=-3\). To add two numbers with the same sign, keep that sign and add their absolute values: \(-(3+4)=-7\).
methods.levelReason: Directly applies the Grade 7 rules for opposite-sign and same-sign addition.
